resources.string: Cohere Arabic · Choose Arabic or English. Automatic language detection is unavailable. Final captions arrive after short utterances.
Fun-ASR MLT Nano · Multilingual utterance captions, including Arabic and English. Auto or an explicit spoken language.

Voxtral Realtime · Recognition accepts no language hint. Choose a known source to label text for translation; Auto leaves the source unknown. Bounded windowed partials; phone performance is unverified.
This native runtime currently requires a 64-bit ARM phone. Model weights are separate from memory usage; device performance needs testing.
